column1: # redteam-baseline.tsv (harbor#1313, decision 23 on harbor#1149) — every external-corpus miss or false positive that is
# ACCEPTED, by id. bin/eval-redteam-corpus.sh is red while any finding is not listed here, and deploy-push's release gate
# reads that. Adding a row needs the operator's review (CODEOWNERS) and a docs/explanation/admission-baseline.md "Residual risks" entry saying why;
# removing one is an ordinary commit. Ids hold only for the pin in redteam-sources.tsv: a new pin re-adjudicates.
# COLUMNS (tab-separated; the first non-comment row is the header)
#   corpus  shguard/<file> or ccg, as the check names it
#   id      miss:<n> or fp:<n>; n is the JSONL line (shguard) or the 1-based row of the harness report (ccg)
#   reason  why it is accepted, and the docs/explanation/admission-baseline.md residual or harbor issue that says so
